knowledge_items.title: Reusable chassis and standard block architecture
knowledge_items.extract: Products should be assembled from reusable chassis, standard blocks and configuration instead of rebuilding the system for every project.

knowledge_items.title: Traceable engineering evidence loop
knowledge_items.extract: Engineering output must remain traceable from requirements through architecture, implementation, tests, defects and reusable patterns.

knowledge_items.title: Topic-oriented resource index linked to engineering outputs
knowledge_items.extract: Organize learning sources by engineering topic, then extend each topic with explicit mapping to capabilities, artifacts, products and evidence.

knowledge_items.title: Prototype is not production
knowledge_items.extract: Rapid LLM prototypes are easy to build, but production use requires explicit accuracy, reliability, latency and cost requirements plus understanding of model failure modes.
knowledge_items.decision: Factory must separate prototype acceptance from production readiness.

knowledge_items.title: Reference RAG prototype pipeline
knowledge_items.extract: A PDF QA prototype consists of parsing, chunking, embeddings, vector storage, query embedding, similarity retrieval, LLM answer generation and conversation history.
knowledge_items.source_scope: Chapter 1 / Building Your First Chatbot Prototype
knowledge_items.decision: Represent RAG as replaceable standard blocks rather than one monolithic application.

knowledge_items.title: Retrieval similarity is not answer relevance
knowledge_items.extract: Embedding similarity can retrieve text similar to a query without guaranteeing that the text contains the answer or is relevant enough to answer it.
knowledge_items.decision: Retriever output must be evaluated; similarity score alone cannot be treated as evidence of answerability.

knowledge_items.title: Model selection must be use-case constrained
knowledge_items.extract: Production model selection should consider capabilities and limitations for the use case, including budget, evaluation criteria and benchmark performance.
knowledge_items.decision: Model Router must depend on Model Registry capability and cost profiles rather than fixed model names.

knowledge_items.title: Tools and autonomous task decomposition are first-class capabilities
knowledge_items.extract: LLM applications can be extended with code interpreters, databases and APIs, and can decompose complex tasks into multiple steps and interact with their environment.
knowledge_items.decision: Tools, permissions and orchestration must be independent Factory registries/blocks.
